history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity ECOR Number Cancellation (Single) details.
features: ECOR Number Cancellation function is used to remove the ECOR Number assigned to a container.

events.description: Opens the ECOR Number Cancellation screen in a new tab
events.triggered_when: User clicks the ☰ icon on the BL record in Depot Activity and selects "ECOR Number Cancellation"

events.description: Queries the records matching the query parameters and lists them in the grid, with the count in Total Record(s)
events.triggered_when: User enters the query parameters (Discharge Voyage, BL Number, Container) and clicks Search

events.description: Clears the query fields and the grid
Selects or deselects all records in the grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks the select-all check box in the grid header

events.description: Selects or deselects the individual record
events.triggered_when: User clicks the check box of a record

events.description: Cancels (removes) the ECOR Numbers of the selected records; the cancelled records are removed from the grid
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records and clicks Process

search.name: Discharge Voyage
search.ui: Input Discharge Voyage. The ⇆ switches the box between Auto Populate (Key in three char) and Alphanumeric

search.name: Discharge Voyage (port call drop down)
search.ui: Select the discharge port call of the entered voyage

search.name: Vessel
search.ui: Vessel of the entered voyage, auto populated (greyed)

search.name: BL Number
search.ui: Input or select the BL Number to filter the records

search.name: Container
search.ui: Input the Container number to filter the records

search.name: Search
search.ui: Queries the records based on the query fields

search.name: Reset
search.ui: Clears the query fields and the grid

display.name: Select All (header check box)
display.ui: If all the queried records are to be processed please select the check box

display.name: Check Box (row)
display.ui: If the record is to be processed please select the check box

display.name: Display
display.ui: Indicates (✓) that the record is displayed/eligible for ECOR Number cancellation

display.name: ECOR Number
display.ui: Current ECOR number of the container (to be cancelled)

display.name: Process
display.ui: Cancels the ECOR Numbers of the selected records
